title: State-of-the-Art AI Detection
description: Powered by latest Claude and GPT models for unmatched accuracy. Automatically detect and redact {PII|Personally Identifiable Information - names, addresses, phone numbers, SSNs}, {PHI|Protected Health Information - medical records, diagnoses, treatment data}, and confidential data across all document formats.

title: Enterprise Security & Compliance
description: {AES-256|Advanced Encryption Standard with 256-bit keys} encryption, zero-trust architecture, and private processing. {GDPR|General Data Protection Regulation} compliant with SOC 2, ISO 27001, {HIPAA|Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act}, and CCPA readiness.

title: Developer Friendly APIs
description: {RESTful APIs|Representational State Transfer - web service architecture} with comprehensive documentation, TypeScript and Python {SDKs|Software Development Kits}. Integration takes minutes, not weeks.

title: Seamless Integrations
description: Connect with Google Drive, Dropbox, AWS S3, and popular platforms. Automate workflows with {webhooks|HTTP callbacks that trigger when events occur} and real-time processing.

title: Flexible Deployment Options
description: Choose cloud-hosted, {on-premises|Software installed and run on your own servers}, or {hybrid deployment|Combination of cloud and on-premises infrastructure}. Works with both cloud APIs and self-hosted servers.

title: Audit-Ready Compliance
description: Comprehensive logging, {audit trails|Chronological record of system activities}, and detailed reporting. Meet compliance requirements with complete {data governance|Framework for managing data availability, usability, integrity and security}.
